doc_class_description: A Sri Lanka Cabinet Decision is an official policy or action agreed by the Cabinet of Ministers, shaping governance, law, and national development in the country.

latest_doc_d.description: Appointment to the Post of Director General of Irrigation
latest_doc_d.decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-17 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
latest_doc_d.decision_details_body: - Mr. I.P.A. Gunasekara, presently serving in the Post of Director General of Irrigation, is scheduled to retire from the Public Service from 2025‑12‑04. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation to appoint Dr. (Eng.) K. Weligepolage, the most senior officer in the Special Grade Civil Category 3 of the Sri Lanka Engineering Service, presently serving as an Additional Director General of the said Department, to the post of Director General of Irrigation falling vacant, with effect from 2025‑12‑04, was approved by the Cabinet.
